model_organism.citation: Sarm1 deletion suppresses TDP-43-linked motor neuron degeneration and cortical spine loss (PMID: 31661035)
phenotypes: Sarm1 deletion in TDP-43Q331K ALS-FTD mice attenuated motor axon degeneration and NMJ denervation
Motor neuron cell bodies were protected
Attenuated loss of layer V pyramidal neuron dendritic spines in motor cortex
Did not rescue age-related behavioural deficits
Increased viability of male TDP-43Q331K mice

model_organism.citation: Deletion of murine Sarm1 results in a microenvironment that delays peripheral nerve regeneration after injury (PMID: 41061042)
phenotypes: Sarm1-/- mice showed delayed activation of injury-induced transcriptional programs in DRG
After sciatic nerve crush, axon regeneration stalled distally and was delayed
Delayed Schwann cell repair response and delayed myelin clearance
Regenerated axons had reduced caliber and aberrant target innervation
Weaker tibial nerve action potentials
Delayed hind paw functional recovery, though ultimately not impaired
Sarm1-/- nerve microenvironment hostile to wild-type axon regeneration

model_organism.citation: Sarm1 knockout modifies biomarkers of neurodegeneration and spinal cord circuitry but not disease progression in the mSOD1(G93A) mouse model of ALS (PMID: 35863521)
phenotypes: Sarm1 loss in mSOD1 mice did not delay onset, improve function, or protect motor neurons
Reduced late increase in serum NFL and GFAP
Protected VGluT2+ excitatory puncta in spinal cord
Attenuated astrogliosis
Restored phosphorylated neurofilament area in sciatic nerve towards WT

model_organism.citation: SARM1 Ablation Is Protective and Preserves Spatial Vision in an In Vivo Mouse Model of Retinal Ganglion Cell Degeneration (PMID: 35163535)
phenotypes: Sarm1-/- mice retained visual function after rotenone insult (preserved photopic negative response, higher optokinetic response)
Increased RGC survival
Preserved optic nerve axonal density
Primary fibroblasts showed increased oxygen consumption rate and basal, maximal, spare respiratory capacity

model_organism.citation: Pharmacological SARM1 inhibition protects axon structure and function in paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy (PMID: 33964142)
phenotypes: Sarm1 knockout prevented loss of tail nerve sensory action potential amplitude in paclitaxel CIPN model in a gene-dosage-dependent manner

model_organism.citation: SARM1 knockout does not rescue neuromuscular phenotypes in a Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease Type 1A mouse model (PMID: 35137510)
phenotypes: SARM1 deletion in C3-PMP CMT1A mice gave no improvement in behavioral, electrophysiological, nerve morphometry or muscle morphology deficits

model_organism.citation: Macrophage depletion blocks congenital SARM1-dependent neuropathy (PMID: 36287209)
phenotypes: Nmnat2 V98M/R232Q compound heterozygous mice developed progressive motor dysfunction, peripheral axon loss and macrophage infiltration
These phenotypes were SARM1-dependent (rescued by Sarm1 deletion)
Macrophage depletion blocked and reversed neuropathy

model_organism.citation: SARM1 promotes neuroinflammation and inhibits neural regeneration after spinal cord injury through NF-κB signaling (PMID: 33754056)
phenotypes: SARM1 Nestin-CKO and GFAP-CKO mice showed normal spinal cord development and motor function
Conditional deletion promoted functional recovery after SCI (BMS, footprint)
Promoted neuronal regeneration and reduced neuroinflammation via downregulated NF-κB signaling, with HSP70 upregulation

model_organism.citation: Metabolic stress drives sympathetic neuropathy within the liver (PMID: 33545051)
phenotypes: Sarm1 deletion mitigated hepatic sympathetic neuropathy in HFD-challenged mice
Improved metabolic parameters

model_organism.citation: Passenger Mutations Confound Phenotypes of SARM1-Deficient Mice (PMID: 32268088)
phenotypes: New B6-background Sarm1 knockout strains confirmed role of SARM1 in axonal degeneration and WNV infection
No role in VSV or LACV infection, or in chemokine or Xaf1 expression
Passenger 129-derived Xaf1 variation may account for phenotypes previously attributed to SARM1

biological.citation: Anon. 2025 - A CRISPR activation screen reveals a cilia disassembly pathway mutated in focal cortical dysplasia (PMID: 41160700)
biological.summary: A genome-wide CRISPRa screen placed SARM1 hydrolase in a pathway (F2R GPCR, SARM1, ryanodine receptors, peri-centrosomal calcium, RhoA) that is necessary and sufficient for cilia disassembly. Patient-derived somatic SARM1 and RhoA variants from focal cortical dysplasia potentiate cilia loss, and SARM1 inhibition restores cilia in cells carrying FCD-associated alterations.

biological.citation: Anon. 2021 - Pharmacological SARM1 inhibition protects axon structure and function in paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy (PMID: 33964142)
biological.summary: SARM1 NADase activity drives Wallerian-like axon degeneration in chemotherapy-induced neuropathy. Irreversible isothiazole SARM1 inhibitors protected rodent and human axons in vitro and lowered nerve cADPR and plasma NfL after axotomy. In the paclitaxel model, Sarm1 knockout protected sensory nerve action potentials in a gene-dosage-dependent manner, and the inhibitors preserved intraepidermal nerve fibres.

biological.citation: Anon. 2025 - SARM1 executes neuronal parthanatos and promotes excitotoxic cell death (PMID: 41997149)
biological.summary: SARM1 is an essential component of neuronal parthanatos, acting downstream of PARP1 hyperactivation. It is required for mitochondrial depolarization, nuclear AIF translocation and cell death after DNA damage. SARM1 inhibition protects against MPP+ toxicity and NMDA excitotoxicity.

biological.citation: Anon. 2025 - METTL1-mediated m(7)G methylation of Sarm1 mRNA promotes macrophage inflammatory responses and multiple organ injury (PMID: 40911698)
biological.summary: METTL1-mediated m7G modification stabilizes Sarm1 mRNA in macrophages. This drives NAD+ decline and metabolic reprogramming with proinflammatory responses. SARM1 overexpression reversed the metabolic defect of METTL1 deficiency.

biological.citation: Anon. 2021 - SARM1 promotes neuroinflammation and inhibits neural regeneration after spinal cord injury through NF-κB signaling (PMID: 33754056)
biological.summary: SARM1 was upregulated in neurons and astrocytes early after spinal cord injury in mice. Conditional deletion in Nestin+ or GFAP+ cells improved functional recovery and neuronal regeneration. It also reduced neuroinflammation through downregulated NF-κB signaling, possibly via HSP70 upregulation. FK866 had similar benefits.

biological.citation: Anon. 2021 - Live imaging reveals the cellular events downstream of SARM1 activation (PMID: 34779400)
biological.summary: Single-axon live imaging of mouse sensory neurons showed that SARM1 NADase activity triggers an ordered sequence of events. These are ATP loss, mitochondrial movement defects and depolarization, calcium influx, phosphatidylserine externalization and loss of membrane permeability, followed by axon self-destruction.

biological.citation: Anon. 2022 - TRPV1 maintains quiescence of hepatic stellate cells via recruitment of SARM1 (PMID: 36669703)
biological.summary: The TRPV1 N-terminal ankyrin repeat domain binds the SARM1 TIR domain (His583). This was shown by mass spectrometry, co-IP, SPR, BRET and NanoBiT. The interaction prevents NF-κB-driven pro-inflammatory activation of hepatic stellate cells, and so limits liver fibrosis.

biological.citation: Anon. 2019 - Sarm1 deletion suppresses TDP-43-linked motor neuron degeneration and cortical spine loss (PMID: 31661035)
biological.summary: Sarm1 deletion in the TDP-43 Q331K ALS-FTD mouse model attenuated motor axon degeneration, NMJ denervation, motor neuron loss and cortical dendritic spine loss. It increased survival in males but did not rescue behavioural deficits.

biological.citation: Anon. 2023 - SARM1 Promotes Neurodegeneration and Memory Impairment in Mouse Models of Alzheimer's Disease (PMID: 37307837)
biological.summary: SARM1 was reduced in hippocampal neurons of APP/PS1 AD mice. CNS conditional knockout delayed cognitive decline and reduced Aβ deposition, inflammatory infiltration and neurodegeneration, with downregulated TNF-α signaling.

biological.citation: Anon. 2021 - Sarm1 is dispensable for mechanosensory-motor transformations in zebrafish (PMID: 33688624)
biological.summary: Zebrafish lacking Sarm1 had normal sensorimotor transformations underlying rheotaxis. Loss of Sarm1 accelerated regrowth of regenerating axons, so systemic Sarm1 inhibition appears compatible with normal nervous system function.

biological.citation: Anon. 2019 - Gene therapy targeting SARM1 blocks pathological axon degeneration in mice (PMID: 30642945)
biological.summary: SARM1 dominant-negative constructs blocked axon degeneration in cellular models of axotomy and neuropathy. AAV-delivered dominant-negative SARM1 kept transected mouse axons intact for more than 10 days, similar to SARM1-null mice.
